sources.name: arXiv API exact-window mathematics census
sources.outcome: Enumerated 1,491 mathematics submissions in the exact America/Chicago window converted to 2026-08-17T05:00Z through 2026-08-24T04:59Z and supplied primary metadata for normalization.

sources.name: arXiv OAI records and version histories
sources.outcome: Screened 773 HA-adjacent records and distinguished original submissions from material in-window revisions before scope assessment.

sources.name: Primary mathematical manuscripts and authoritative records
sources.outcome: Checked all 57 plausible unique candidates against arXiv manuscripts, DOI or publisher records, author and institute pages, official repositories, and inspectable certificates as available.

sources.name: Axiom bounded-prime-gaps formalization and independent coverage
sources.outcome: Verified the formal artifact, disclosed mixed human/AI workflow, and qualifying in-window IEEE Spectrum coverage.

sources.name: ICARM elliptic-rank records and institute coverage
sources.outcome: Verified explicit rank-at-least-30 and rank-at-least-31 witnesses, ICARM validation policy, event chronology, and qualifying in-window coverage for the linked record cluster.

sources.name: Targeted web, news, author-page, and repository discovery
sources.outcome: Supplied independent context and corroboration for plausible candidates; weak, marketing-led, unsigned, or insufficiently inspectable claims were retained only as nonselected or verification-pending evidence.

statistics.candidate_count_scope: Raw, normalized, and deduplicated counts describe the exact-window arXiv mathematics census; revision feeds and external AI-math events were assessed separately and are included in the plausible-candidate knowledge base.

ranking_audit.title_en: Linear dependence of time-frequency shifts of a Schwartz function
ranking_audit.title_zh: Schwartz 函数时频平移的线性相关性
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Ranked first because the in-window revision materially strengthens a central HA counterexample with a nonnumerical existence proof.

ranking_audit.title_en: A dimension-free weak-type $(1,1)$ bound for the vector Riesz transform on $\mathbb{R}^n$
ranking_audit.title_zh: $\mathbb{R}^n$ 上向量 Riesz 变换的无维数弱 $(1,1)$ 型界
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A longstanding endpoint problem is resolved with an absolute quantitative constant and a new method.

ranking_audit.title_en: Endpoint orthonormal Strichartz estimates
ranking_audit.title_zh: 端点正交归一 Strichartz 估计
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected near the top for closing named endpoint conjectures in an unusually general framework.

ranking_audit.title_en: Mixed-norm Brascamp--Lieb inequalities
ranking_audit.title_zh: 混合范数 Brascamp–Lieb 不等式
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A foundational-looking new inequality framework with direct restriction and Kakeya relevance.

ranking_audit.title_en: Sharp Bilinear Decoupling under Shell-Type Restrictions and Applications
ranking_audit.title_zh: 壳型限制下的尖锐双线性解耦及其应用
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A core decoupling advance with a sharp regime change and several concrete HA/PDE consequences.

ranking_audit.title_en: Global solutions for 1D cubic defocusing dispersive equations, Part V: low regularity NLS
ranking_audit.title_zh: 一维三次散焦色散方程的整体解，第五部分：低正则性 NLS
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A robust near-critical global theory for a broad nonintegrable dispersive class.

ranking_audit.title_en: $L^p$-Estimates for maximal averages along mixed homogeneous hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$
ranking_audit.title_zh: $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中混合齐次超曲面上极大平均算子的 $L^p$ 估计
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A broad critical-exponent theorem for geometrically degenerate maximal averages.

ranking_audit.title_en: Positive measure for restricted projections along smooth non-degenerate curves
ranking_audit.title_zh: 沿光滑非退化曲线的受限投影具有正测度
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A strong restricted-projection theorem in all admissible dimensions.

ranking_audit.title_en: Boundary-Weighted Fourier Inequalities for Convex Domains
ranking_audit.title_zh: 凸域上的边界加权 Fourier 不等式
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A sharp convex-frequency-domain theory with unusually direct restriction/Kakeya implications.

ranking_audit.title_en: Almost sure pointwise convergence for the 2D periodic quintic NLS
ranking_audit.title_zh: 二维周期五次 NLS 的几乎处处逐点收敛
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A substantial probabilistic threshold improvement for a nonlinear Carleson problem.

ranking_audit.title_en: Bourgain's condition, sticky Kakeya, and new examples
ranking_audit.title_zh: Bourgain 条件、黏性 Kakeya 与新例子
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A material accepted revision on a central curved-Kakeya mechanism.

ranking_audit.title_en: High-dimensional discrete 1-symmetric convex bodies and dimension-free estimates for maximal functions
ranking_audit.title_zh: 高维离散 1-对称凸体与极大函数的无维数估计
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A broad dimension-free theorem paired with a meaningful symmetry counterexample.

ranking_audit.title_en: Cellular Maximal-Density Factoring and a Repair of the Streamlined Three-Dimensional Kakeya Reduction
ranking_audit.title_zh: 细胞极大密度分解与三维 Kakeya 简化归约的修补
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Potentially consequential proof-integrity work, ranked below new theorems pending specialist verification.

ranking_audit.title_en: Complexity-sensitive additive energy and off-diagonal Young inequalities on bounded-degree algebraic varieties
ranking_audit.title_zh: 有界次数代数簇上的复杂度敏感加性能量与非对角 Young 不等式
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A technically rich new bridge between algebraic additive structure and restriction estimates.

ranking_audit.title_en: Anisotropic Bourgain--Brezis inequalities
ranking_audit.title_zh: 各向异性 Bourgain–Brezis 不等式
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A core endpoint/cancellation result with a substantial proof, despite limited high-level source detail.

ranking_audit.title_en: On the prime field spherical restriction conjecture in four dimensions: breaking the Stein--Tomas exponent and applications
ranking_audit.title_zh: 四维素域球面限制猜想：突破 Stein–Tomas 指数及其应用
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A material finite-field restriction revision with a new localized theory and applications.

ranking_audit.title_en: Universal admissibility for scattering transforms
ranking_audit.title_zh: 散射变换的普适可容许性
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Resolves a named admissibility issue and sharply identifies the attainable depth-decay scale.

ranking_audit.title_en: Uniform weak type $(1,1)$ bounds for Riesz transforms on stratified Lie groups
ranking_audit.title_zh: 分层 Lie 群上 Riesz 变换的一致弱 $(1,1)$ 型界
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A striking universal-constant extension across all stratified Lie groups.

ranking_audit.title_en: Critical two-depth Journé packing for bi-parameter and Zygmund rectangles
ranking_audit.title_zh: 双参数与 Zygmund 矩形的临界双深度 Journé 装填
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A sharp endpoint refinement of a central multiparameter tool.

ranking_audit.title_en: Time-Decay Estimates for Two-Dimensional Fourth-Order Schrödinger Operators with Threshold Singularities
ranking_audit.title_zh: 具有阈值奇性的二维四阶 Schrödinger 算子的时间衰减估计
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A broad threshold-resonance decay classification with sharp lower behavior.

ranking_audit.title_en: Entry growth in Gaussian elimination
ranking_audit.title_zh: 高斯消元中的元素增长
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Ranked first for resolving several long-standing stability questions with broad theoretical and algorithmic consequences.

ranking_audit.title_en: On Chern's conjecture for minimal submanifolds of the sphere
ranking_audit.title_zh: 关于球面中极小子流形的 Chern 猜想
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A compact explicit counterexample family to a famous geometric discreteness conjecture.

ranking_audit.title_en: Banach's Isometric Conjecture over the Complex Field
ranking_audit.title_zh: 复数域上的 Banach 等距猜想
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for extending a classical theorem to the complex and quaternionic settings with broad geometric consequences.

ranking_audit.title_en: A Complete Classification of Complex Hadamard Matrices of Order Six
ranking_audit.title_zh: 六阶复 Hadamard 矩阵的完整分类
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A decades-open classification claim supported by substantial formal and computational evidence.

ranking_audit.title_en: Thompson's Conjecture for Finite Simple Groups of Lie Type over Small Fields
ranking_audit.title_zh: 小有限域上 Lie 型有限单群的 Thompson 猜想
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Completes a long finite-group program by resolving its known residual families.

ranking_audit.title_en: Concentration phenomena and the Vanishing Mass Conjecture
ranking_audit.title_zh: 集中现象与消失质量猜想
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A broad structural resolution of a 2003 conjecture with several downstream applications.

ranking_audit.title_en: Sharp Summability of Nevanlinna Defects for Finite-Lower-Order Holomorphic Curves
ranking_audit.title_zh: 有限下级全纯曲线的 Nevanlinna 亏量的尖锐可和性
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A sharp endpoint resolution in classical value-distribution theory.

ranking_audit.title_en: A 15/31 Counterexample Family to the Albertson-Berman Conjecture
ranking_audit.title_zh: Albertson–Berman 猜想的一族 15/31 反例
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: An explicit, reproducible disproof of a 47-year-old conjecture.

ranking_audit.title_en: Lean formalization of bounded gaps between primes
ranking_audit.title_zh: 有界素数间隙的 Lean 形式化
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: The strongest AI-math item because it combines inspectable formal evidence, a disclosed mixed human/AI workflow, and reputable in-window coverage.

ranking_audit.title_en: Elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}$ of rank at least 30 and 31
ranking_audit.title_zh: 秩至少为 30 和 31 的 $\mathbb{Q}$ 上椭圆曲线
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: A genuine new mathematical record with explicit witnesses and authoritative in-window coverage, treated as one tightly linked event cluster.
